timeline.summary: On 23 April 2026, Crisil Ratings reaffirmed Standard Engineering Technology's long-term rating at Crisil A and short-term at Crisil A1, revising the long-term outlook to Positive from Stable; material subsidiary S2 Engineering Industry's ratings were also reaffirmed at Crisil A/A1 with the outlook revised to Positive.
On May 12, 2026, Standard Engineering Technology incorporated a subsidiary, Standard Projects Private Limited, with a 75% stake.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹226.68 Cr (+36.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹19.8 Cr (+31.1% YoY).
Standard Engineering Technology hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 15, 2026, discussing financial performance and future growth strategies.
Standard Engineering Technology allotted 24,39,750 equity shares on a preferential basis to non-promoter investors aggregating to ₹71.48 crore.
